episode.showDescription: The official podcast of comedian Joe Rogan.
episode.episodeDescription: Jimmy Donaldson, better known as MrBeast, is a YouTuber, entrepreneur, and philanthropist. He is the founder of Beast Industries and Beast Philanthropy, and the creator and host of the Prime Video competition series “Beast Games.”www.beastgames.comwww.beastphilanthropy.orgwww.youtube.com/@MrBeast Learn more about your ad choices. Visit podcastchoices.com/adchoices

transcript_window.text: I love how you call it show, and to me it's just a YouTube video, but it's just funny.
It's a show.
Yeah, I know, of course.
It makes sense because you do stuff with the UFC, and you're old, a lot of it's called shows.
I mean, whatever it is, people are watching it.
Yeah, know.
It's just funny to me.
I haven't heard it called that in years.
But, yeah, that one was crazy.
I mean, one thing that I'm really proud of that we did for Season 3 of Beast Games, which in hindsight I'm not even sure how this one we pulled off.
So I want to see your reaction to this.
So basically the finale where we have the $5 million, we have the final contestants.
We filmed it in the Roman Coliseum.
Whoa.
Yeah.
We crowned the winner of season three with the $5 million cash prize in the middle of the Roman Coliseum.
Played the first game there in over a thousand years.
Wow.
That's crazy.
I'm so grateful.
Like we just filmed that too.
So I'm like coming off the high and I just like, like it almost makes, like gives me tears.

shot was so cool we had like a live orchestra like the top ring up there too so like as the game got dramatic we would have them like play louder music and stuff it was like so surreal like there's multiple because i've done really crazy things in my life but there's multiple moments during that where i'm just like looking around in the middle of coliseum as we're like filming

this show and i'm like like this doesn't feel real it was pretty wild it doesn't feel i i mean i went just to visit a few years back and it didn't feel real it's so strange to imagine like what that was like, you know, how many thousand years ago?
What year were they doing the games in the Roman Colosseum?
I would guess 1900 years ago.
